info.title: Netanyahu Trial Knowledge API
info.description: Public, citation-first API over the official protocols of criminal case 67104-01-20. Public endpoints return published objects only. Admin endpoints require a signed service-account request (headers X-NTK-Key-Id, X-NTK-Timestamp, X-NTK-Nonce, X-NTK-Actor, X-NTK-Signature; see ADR-0004).
